what: A public list price. The lab uses it to say what a free model's tokens would cost at a hosted model. It is never a bill.
tier: Standard processing, a request of 272,000 input tokens or fewer
cached_input: Never applied to a call: the lab's free models report no cached tokens, so every input token is priced at the full input price. tools/price.py uses it for one line only, the lowest a sum could be if every input token were billed as cached.
